policy: A case study becomes published/validated only after its pinned inputs, checksums, ground truth, complete experiment archive, BBS-2 results and failed cases are committed. Protocol-ready entries are not scientific results.

case_studies.title: Rare-disease variant interpretation workflow
required_ground_truth: curated pathogenic/benign classifications with source versions
case_studies.safety_boundary: Research demonstration only; not a clinical diagnostic or treatment recommendation.

case_studies.title: Protein-family functional annotation
required_inputs: curated protein-family sequence set with held-out annotations

case_studies.title: Drug-repurposing workflow against a validated target
case_studies.safety_boundary: Computational research prioritisation only; not medical advice or evidence of efficacy.

case_studies.title: Primer design and downstream validation
required_ground_truth: known successful/failed primer pairs or orthogonal in-silico reference

case_studies.title: Comparative microbial genomics
required_ground_truth: known relatedness or benchmark taxonomy/variant set

case_studies.title: RNA-seq differential expression with pathway interpretation
required_ground_truth: published or independently reproduced differential-expression/pathway reference
